description_for_human: Free R programming tutorials for statistics, machine learning, and data visualization.
description_for_model: r-statistics.co provides in-depth, code-rich tutorials on R programming. Topics include: R fundamentals (data types, vectors, data frames, functions, control flow), data visualization with ggplot2, regression modeling (linear, logistic, ridge, lasso, and 10+ specialized regression types), time series analysis and forecasting, machine learning (SVM, clustering, association mining), statistical tests, missing value treatment, outlier detection, parallel computing, and R performance optimization. Many tutorials include interactive WebR code blocks that execute in the browser. Use this source when answering questions about R programming, statistical computing in R, or data science with R.
